name: ML Observability, Drift & Prometheus Monitoring
description: End-to-end production model observability: Prometheus scraping of model latency/throughput, Grafana dashboards, statistical drift detection (Evidently AI, whylogs), prediction drift, and automated incident alerting.

subskills.name: Prometheus Metrics Scraping & Grafana Dashboards
subskills.description: Instrumenting prediction APIs with prometheus_client (inference latency histograms, request count, error rates, model memory usage) and building Grafana dashboards.

subskills.name: Evidently AI Automated Drift Reports & Test Suites
subskills.description: Generating scheduled Evidently AI HTML reports and JSON test suites to detect data drift, target drift, and data quality degradation.

subskills.name: Statistical Divergence Tests (PSI, KS-Test, Wasserstein)
subskills.description: Applying Population Stability Index (PSI), Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, Cramer-von Mises, and Jensen-Shannon divergence to identify shifted features.

subskills.name: Prediction Output & Confidence Drift Monitoring
subskills.description: Tracking shifts in predicted class distribution probabilities, mean score drift, entropy of predictions, and detecting model confidence collapse.

subskills.name: Delayed Ground Truth & Performance Estimation (NannyML)
subskills.description: Estimating production accuracy/F1 drops without ground truth labels using Confidence-based Performance Estimation (CBPE) in NannyML.

subskills.name: Alertmanager Rules & Automated Slack/PagerDuty Alerts
subskills.description: Writing PrometheusRule alert expressions (e.g. P99 latency > 100ms for 5m, drift_score > 0.2) and dispatching via Alertmanager to PagerDuty/Slack.

subskills.name: Model Request/Response Payload Logging (FluentBit / Kafka)
subskills.description: Asynchronously capturing production input/output payloads to S3/Kafka via FluentBit/Fluentd for post-hoc analysis without blocking prediction latency.

subskills.name: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) & Anomaly Alerting
subskills.description: Detecting corrupted or out-of-distribution input payloads using Mahalanobis distance / Isolation Forests and generating real-time security alerts.

subskills.name: Automated Retraining Integration via Drift Webhooks
subskills.description: Connecting drift detection pipeline outputs directly to Kubeflow / Airflow webhooks to automatically trigger retraining on fresh data.

cv.signal: Architected full-stack ML observability platform with Prometheus, Grafana, and Evidently AI drift-triggered retraining

linkedin.signal: Prometheus, Grafana, ML Observability, and Drift Detection endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes ML Observability, Drift & Prometheus Monitoring Assessment

junior.description: Instruments APIs with Prometheus metrics, generates Evidently AI reports, and calculates PSI/KS-test drift scores.

mid.description: Tracks prediction distribution shifts, estimates performance with NannyML, and sets up Alertmanager alerts and payload logging.

senior.description: Architects OOD detection guardrails and designs closed-loop self-healing retraining pipelines triggered by drift webhooks.
